tasks.title: Preserve ridge seams while changing terrain LOD
tasks.objective: Implement a bounded LOD experiment that retains shared-edge positions and source elevations.
acceptance: Adjacent tile edges agree at mixed strides.
Triangle count and elevation/provenance are reported for both budgets.
Before/after close ridge images retain spurs and silhouette.

rubric.criterion: Adjacent tile edges agree at mixed strides.
Triangle count and elevation/provenance are reported for both budgets.
Before/after close ridge images retain spurs and silhouette.

tasks.title: Improve raster reconstruction without losing the terrain pixel identity
tasks.objective: Make a focused pixel treatment improvement; show identical controls and explain the intended image change.
acceptance: Native grid dimensions stay correct.
Retired Depth/Palette options are not reintroduced.
Classic/Detailed actual images and an explicit reference decision are retained.

rubric.criterion: Native grid dimensions stay correct.
Retired Depth/Palette options are not reintroduced.
Classic/Detailed actual images and an explicit reference decision are retained.

tasks.title: Add an observable bounded musical response
tasks.objective: Add one music-to-environment response driven by heard-time features; preserve quiet passages and seek determinism.
acceptance: Silence does not produce false activity.
Heard clock, repeated seeks and late analysis are consistent.
Matching audio/frames demonstrate the response rather than a test-only value.

rubric.criterion: Silence does not produce false activity.
Heard clock, repeated seeks and late analysis are consistent.
Matching audio/frames demonstrate the response rather than a test-only value.

tasks.title: Keep a growing summit composed across seek and replay
tasks.objective: Improve one growing-range framing condition without abrupt camera motion or underground travel.
acceptance: Focus projects inside the intended frame across sampled growth.
Clearance and full-height authored pose remain valid.
A consecutive clip demonstrates smoothness and direct seeks reconstruct the same pose.

rubric.criterion: Focus projects inside the intended frame across sampled growth.
Clearance and full-height authored pose remain valid.
A consecutive clip demonstrates smoothness and direct seeks reconstruct the same pose.

tasks.title: Reduce a measured cost while preserving output
tasks.objective: Select one demonstrated hot path, establish a comparable baseline, optimize it and retain honest environment labels.
acceptance: Actual output/geometry hashes or reviewed differences accompany the timing.
Same-environment distributions show the claimed reduction.
No allocations bypass admission and no desktop timings are labeled JOYING results.

rubric.criterion: Actual output/geometry hashes or reviewed differences accompany the timing.
Same-environment distributions show the claimed reduction.
No allocations bypass admission and no desktop timings are labeled JOYING results.

tasks.title: Reject an invalid source without inventing terrain
tasks.objective: Add a malformed/no-data fixture and preserve source checks, coordinate orientation and fallback.
acceptance: Missing heights remain missing rather than silently becoming zero.
Tampered manifests/payloads are rejected and source attribution survives.
Valid supplied geography still loads; rejected data reaches a usable fallback.

rubric.criterion: Missing heights remain missing rather than silently becoming zero.
Tampered manifests/payloads are rejected and source attribution survives.
Valid supplied geography still loads; rejected data reaches a usable fallback.

tasks.title: Diagnose an actual reproduced failure
tasks.objective: Select a real failing behavior or inject a clearly labeled temporary fault; reproduce, trace root cause and repair without relaxing acceptance.
acceptance: A test fails before the fix and passes after it.
The fix addresses the production consumer and removes the injected fault if used.
Final diff and all unaddressed baseline failures are reported.

rubric.criterion: A test fails before the fix and passes after it.
The fix addresses the production consumer and removes the injected fault if used.
Final diff and all unaddressed baseline failures are reported.

tasks.title: Improve one Android control at the real constrained viewport
tasks.objective: Make one focused touch/scroll/fullscreen improvement for the head unit; retain settings and functional hit testing.
acceptance: Control is usable without obscuring the stage on a declared viewport/DPR.
Fullscreen and restored preferences remain coherent.
Actual UI screenshot/hit testing is retained and device absence is declared.

rubric.criterion: Control is usable without obscuring the stage on a declared viewport/DPR.
Fullscreen and restored preferences remain coherent.
Actual UI screenshot/hit testing is retained and device absence is declared.

tasks.title: Trace the actual render and fallback lifecycle
tasks.objective: Produce a source-linked trace of upload through frame, including cancellation, admission and fallback; correct one stale navigation claim if found.
acceptance: Caller/consumer references are current and reachable.
Experimental paths are distinguished from active paths.
Asset failure, generation ownership and shared-frame contracts are explained accurately.

rubric.criterion: Caller/consumer references are current and reachable.
Experimental paths are distinguished from active paths.
Asset failure, generation ownership and shared-frame contracts are explained accurately.

tasks.title: Make a narrow feature change with an evidence-backed PR
tasks.objective: Implement a small requested improvement on a feature branch and deliver a reproducible handoff and reviewable diff.
acceptance: No unrelated features, secrets or default-branch mutations appear.
Relevant tests/build and evidence are recorded; limitations are explicit.
Handoff branch/files/next action match Git and a reviewable PR/diff exists.

rubric.criterion: No unrelated features, secrets or default-branch mutations appear.
Relevant tests/build and evidence are recorded; limitations are explicit.
Handoff branch/files/next action match Git and a reviewable PR/diff exists.
